usage-accounting.facts.title: Usage evidence
usage-accounting.facts.help: Execution receipts and manual confirmations are recorded separately for this attempt.
usage-accounting.facts.unavailable: Usage evidence is unavailable for this attempt.
usage-accounting.title: Usage & allowances
usage-accounting.intro: Monthly execution facts recorded after this ledger was enabled, with configured cost estimates. Earlier runs are not backfilled or inferred; currencies stay separate.
usage-accounting.priced_portion: Amounts include only the priced and reported portion. Unpriced or unknown execution does not mean free usage.
usage-accounting.organization_enforced: An organization allowance also applies. Organization totals are visible only to authorized organization administrators.
usage-accounting.organization_observe: Organization enforcement is off. Organization totals are visible only to authorized organization administrators.
usage-accounting.admission_only: Allowances control admission to managed execution. Reservations are estimates, not a provider spending cap or bill.
usage-accounting.decimal_help: Currency units, using a decimal point and up to 6 decimal places. No rounding is applied.
usage-accounting.zero_limit: A limit of 0 permits no new usage; unlimited is a separate setting.
usage-accounting.enforce_ack: I understand that new managed attempts may be blocked by these allowances, missing pricing, or a currency mismatch. This does not stop provider charges already incurred.
usage-accounting.rate_help: Operator-configured estimates per one million input or output tokens. Cached, cache-write and reasoning counters do not add charges here. No provider prices are imported.
usage-accounting.no_profiles: No enabled read-only Suma model profile has a fixed model and endpoint configured. Configure one in tool settings first. Pricing configuration does not require the tool to be online.
usage-accounting.profile_coverage: More profiles exist beyond this loaded page. Use tool settings to inspect them.
usage-accounting.not_health: This is model configuration, not verified provider account health.
usage-accounting.rate_not_loaded: This profile's current rate revision is outside the loaded range. A revision of 0 cannot safely be assumed; saving is disabled.
usage-accounting.output_floor: At least 4096, and no lower than the actual node output limit. The server checks each claim.
usage-accounting.reservation_help: Choose a conservative input estimate. Reservations do not impose an input or provider spending cap; actual overruns remain recorded.
usage-accounting.counter_help: Input and output form the reported token total. The other counters are shown as reported and are never added to that total. Missing values are unknown, not zero.
usage-accounting.no_attempts: No managed execution attempts recorded for this month and filter.
usage-accounting.overrun: Reported usage exceeded the reservation. Actual usage remains recorded and may block future admission.
usage-accounting.source.none: Source: no complete usage evidence yet.
usage-accounting.source.tool_evidence: Source: final tool evidence. This is not a provider invoice.
usage-accounting.source.host_model_gatew: Source: host model gateway request records. Usage coverage and settlement are separate; this is not a provider invoice.
usage-accounting.source.manual_confirmat: Source: manual confirmation. Original tool evidence is retained; this is not a provider report.
usage-accounting.confirm_help: Record a complete manual confirmation with input and output counts. Every previously known counter must be retained or increased. Unknown optional counters may remain blank; original evidence is preserved.
usage-accounting.confirm_ack: I confirm these counts and their source. This is a manual confirmation, not a vendor usage report; it will settle the estimate and retained reservation.
usage-accounting.restore_help: Recover the same saved request and operation key before making another change. Its original target, counts, currency and reason are retained.
usage-accounting.invalid_read: The usage response does not match the current project or expected data contract.
usage-accounting.refresh_failed: Current usage facts could not be refreshed. The draft has been retained.
usage-accounting.access_changed: Current authority no longer permits this change. Reload the current project view.
usage-accounting.confirm_changed: This attempt is no longer in the loaded page or cannot be confirmed. Inspect the current source before deciding.
